boards.name: apna
boards.notes: Homepage shows a 'Post job' button and copyright 'Apna | All rights reserved'. No headquarters, parent, language options, pricing, API or partner information stated. /pricing, /partners, /employers and /developers returned HTTP 404.

boards.name: CIEE
boards.notes: Partner program is for educational institutions, not for job-posting integrations. Employer page ('Contrate com o CIEE') shows no prices or business model. No headquarters, parent, language selector or API found.

sources.title: Partner page for institutions
sources.quote: Sua Instituição de Ensino pode ser parceira

boards.name: Jobstoday Ltd.
boards.business_model: free job posting; pay per application, click, interview or hire; homepage also lists subscription plans
boards.notes: Homepage lists a 'Recruiter Pro' plan at EUR 89.99 a month, while the employer page says 'No subscriptions.' Employer page names Bullhorn and SAP HCM integrations and a Harvest API, but no public API documentation was found (/en/api returned HTTP 404). Language selector links were seen (en, es, pl, de) but no verbatim quote was captured.

sources.title: Homepage job posting offer
sources.quote: Unlimited job posts, with 5 ATS screened applications free on every job.

sources.title: Employer pricing
sources.quote: No subscriptions. No setup fees. Start hiring without risk.

sources.title: Employer pricing
sources.quote: Pay only for verified, matching applications, nothing else.

sources.title: Employer integrations
sources.quote: Import and update your jobs instantly via XML feed, no manual effort needed.

sources.title: Employer integrations
sources.quote: ATS sync, candidate & job data, real-time pipeline updates.

boards.name: Vieclam.net
boards.parent: Công ty Cổ phần Định Anh
boards.business_model: free basic job posting; paid per-post packages and paid add-ons (prices in images, not in text)
boards.notes: Homepage gives the head office address in Ho Chi Minh City. Describes Vieclam.net as a product of Công ty Cổ phần Định Anh. Price list says prices are updated for 10/2026 and include VAT, but the amounts are not in the page text. No API, developer, partner or language options found.

sources.title: Head office address
sources.quote: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh, Việt Nam.

sources.title: About Vieclam.net
sources.quote: Vieclam.net là một sản phẩm mới của Công ty Cổ phần Định Anh

sources.title: Service price list
sources.quote: Vieclam.net cung cấp 3 lựa chọn gói đăng tuyển tối ưu theo nhu cầu của quý khách từ cơ bản đến cao cấp.

boards.name: Maison de Talents
boards.business_model: free up to 3 postings a month; one-time payment per extra posting credit; per-use boosts; no subscription
boards.notes: Partner page is for recruitment agencies. Employer page states the free allowance and one-time purchases, with prices on the separate pricing page (not read). Footer gives a Korean business registration number, but no headquarters country is stated. No API or developer page found.

sources.title: Employer services
sources.quote: 더 필요할 때만 공고 등록권을 1회 결제하시면 됩니다(구독 아님).

boards.name: Verde Talent
boards.business_model: per post: from $100 for one post; packs of 5 and 10 posts at lower per-post prices
boards.notes: Homepage shows per-post prices and pack pricing. Pricing page returned HTTP 404 and partner page returned HTTP 404. No headquarters, parent, language options, API or ingest information stated.

sources.title: Homepage pricing
sources.quote: Pack posts run 30 days each and can be used any time within 12 months.

boards.name: MakersJob
boards.notes: Footer names the operator 株式会社MyVision and gives a Tokyo address. Footer lists group services, but no parent company is named. Homepage has no pricing, language options, API or partner information. /company/, /corporate/, /partner/ and /for-company/ all returned HTTP 404.

sources.title: Footer address

boards.name: Adcorp Holdings
boards.notes: Homepage states the group operates throughout South Africa and Australia, with a Gallo Manor address and a +27 phone number. No headquarters country is explicitly stated. Footer reads 'Copyright © Adcorp Holdings Limited'. No pricing, language options, API or partner information found. /connect/ is a contact page and /employers/ returned HTTP 404.
